summary: FAIL on one new Medium finding. The D-038 repairs work for every case they target. The round-21 fail-open shapes (QA21-C3/C4/C5/C5b/C5c/C5d) are now rejected for all roles. A shallow clone is refused and a complete one is not. A finding imported from a record-less sidecar and then deleted is caught as dropped. Prototype-named keys are rejected by the real schema. The genuine superseded-round shape (real round 18 in a --no-local clone, and QA22-N6) is still tolerated. The full-history dry-run shows 0 PRUNED, RECORD-LESS and DROPPED errors; every remaining error is a round-not-finished artifact. All required commands and prefreeze pass. Register integrity, agent setup, the live guard and feasibility all pass. I close F-DG0-245 and F-DG0-238 as CLOSED_VERIFIED. New: F-DG0-246 (Medium). The checkClosure fix-absent tolerance keys on a round's source_commit being absent, and orchestrator-written metadata alone can declare that. A genuine run then closes a High finding with an all-zero fix_revision, and validateGate reports 0 errors. No real closure depends on the tolerance, so it can be dropped or tied to an absent run head. Also two Lows: F-DG0-247 (D-038's 'uniformly absent' does not hold for local-path clones; outcome identical) and F-DG0-248 (no unit test for the shallow refusal).
